relocation_line: I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Entry-Level Construction Materials Testing Technician role with Coffey Testing at your Adelaide Laboratory, advertised on SEEK. Your advert says a new starter works alongside experienced technicians in the laboratory and on construction sites, collecting samples, performing tests and recording results.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on construction sites in the Philippines. As project-in-charge engineer I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As field engineer I assisted with site inspections and quality checks and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports. In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks and pavement systems.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. Could we arrange a call to talk about the role?

Marc Masarate
verify_before_submit: SEEK apply links out to the Coffey Testing careers site: confirm the Adelaide St Marys entry-level CMT advert is still open
This is a separate advert from the queued Werribee entry (seek-95393367); do not submit both through one portal form if the portal merges them
notes: Advert: entry level, training academy in week one, lab and site sampling and testing, results into Geotester; manual licence advantageous only; must lift 15kg repeatedly. No mandatory bar found.
